_comment: vLLM single-node DeepSeek-V4-Flash baseline on MI455X: TP4 PP1, AITER on, FP8 KV cache; no MTP, no TunableOp, stock RCCL. Set paths.shared_fs and server_params.model before running.

paths._comment: Host and container paths for model access, artifacts, and Hugging Face authentication.

container._comment: Container definition and static environment inherited by server and benchmark commands.
container.name: vllm_deepseek-v4-flash_fp8_single_mi455x

args._comment_bnxt_mount: Broadcom Thor2 (bnxt_re). Bind-mounts host /usr/local/lib/libbnxt_re-rdmav34.so read-only onto the container libibverbs provider path. Delete this entry when the nodes have no Thor2 library; docker run fails if the host path is missing.
args._comment_ionic_mounts: AMD Pensando Ionic / AINIC. Bind-mounts libionic.so, libionic.so.1, the versioned libionic.so.1.* soname, libibverbs/libionic-rdmav34.so, and /etc/libibverbs.d/ionic.driver. Replace <changeme-libionic-soname> with the filename from readlink -f /usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libionic.so.1. Delete these entries when the nodes have no Ionic stack; docker run fails if a host path is missing.

server_params._comment: Harness fields plus snake-case vllm serve options.

benchmark_params._comment: Default vllm bench serve settings; per-cell values in sweeps override these defaults.

_comment_sweeps: Canonical run cells; entries override benchmark_params for that cell.
_comment_runs: Explicit ordered run cells to execute.
